postings.title: Senior accountant
postings.text:
ABOUT WATERSHED

Watershed https://watershed.com/ is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team.



We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!




THE ROLE

We are looking for a hands-on, tech-forward Senior Accountant to own key pillars of our Corporate General Ledger, month-end financial close, and financial reporting engine.

This is a US GAAP-based role supporting our global, consolidated reporting; knowledge of Mexican statutory/monthly reporting requirements or UK GAAP is a plus, not a requirement.

In this role, you will take ownership of critical areas of our balance sheet and P&L. Beyond standard corporate accounting, you will own the complex accounting for our carbon credits offerings to ensure audit-ready accuracy and tracking.

This is a build-and-scale role for someone who thrives in complexity and cares deeply about accuracy. You will partner cross-functionally with FP&A, Sales, Accounting Systems, and Payroll to turn evolving business needs into scalable, audit-ready accounting frameworks.

We are heavily focused on close acceleration and modernizing our accounting operations. You will partner with our team to help evaluate, test, and implement AI tools, data automation, and modern workflows to transition manual close mechanics into automated subledgers while maintaining an audit-ready standard.



What You’ll Do



Core GL Close, Financial Reporting & Flux Analysis

 - Own the GL close for core balance sheet accounts, including Cash, Prepaids, Fixed Assets, Leases, Accruals, Payroll Liabilities, and short/long-term account classifications.

 - Record monthly Stock-based Compensation (“SBC”) journal entries, track early exercise activity, and reconcile equity-related balance sheet accounts.

 - Assist in building monthly US GAAP Financial Statements while maintaining period-end cutoff discipline.

 - Perform monthly flux analysis to explain business drivers, spot trends or anomalies, and ensure financial accuracy.

 - Identify close bottlenecks and implement process improvements that reduce cycle time without sacrificing precision or control quality.
   
   

Carbon Credits and Treasury

 - Own the end-to-end accounting for our carbon credit offerings, adjustments, and monthly reconciliations.

 - Manage cash reconciliations and accounting for marketable securities, interest income, and investment gains/losses.



 Global Intercompany, Tax & Statutory Compliance 

 - Support and maintain the group-level intercompany framework, including elimination logic and transaction-flow documentation.

 - Support sales tax and VAT filings and compliance across various domestic and international jurisdictions in partnership with tax advisors.

 - Serve as a key point of contact for your owned accounts, preparing audit schedules and supporting workpapers.



Process Building, Systems & AI Automation 

 - Document and standardize workflows for owned accounts.

 - Help build, test, and deploy AI tooling, data automation, and modern workflows to streamline rules-based tasks, accelerate reconciliations, and improve exception management.

 - Partnering with finance systems leads to contributing accounting requirements for ERP upgrades, subledger configurations, and tool integrations.



You Might Thrive in This Role If You Have:

 - 5+ years of progressive accounting experience spanning Big 4 or national public accounting and high-growth SaaS environments.

 - Strong command of US GAAP across core GL areas, including inventory, payroll, fixed assets, prepaids, leases, investments, and intercompany consolidations.

 - Hands-on experience owning a portfolio of accounts through month-end close, reconciliations, and journal entries, ideally within a multi-entity or global accounting environment.

 - Working knowledge of ERP systems (e.g. NetSuite, Workday, Rillet), and advanced Excel/Google Sheets experience. Excited by the opportunity to help evaluate, test, and implement AI tools and data automation.

 - Exceptional ability to work independently, thrive in ambiguity, and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication with the ability to solve complex accounting questions without obvious answers and translate financial results into plain language for non-accounting stakeholders.

 - Knowledge of Mexican statutory accounting (SAT compliance) and/or UK GAAP is a plus.

 - Fluency in English is required.

 - Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field, plus CPA, CPC (Contador Público Certificado), or an international equivalent preferred. 



   





   

Must be willing to work from an office 4 days per week (except for remote roles)

Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. Where we have offices, employees are expected to be in office for 4 days per week. Certain jobs are open to being remote and will be specifically noted on the jobs page and in the job description if so.



What’s the interview process like?

It starts the same for every candidate: getting to know the team members through 1 to 2 conversations about Watershed, your experience, and your interests. Next steps can vary by role, but usual next steps are a skill or experience interview (e.g. a coding interview for an engineer, a portfolio review for a designer, deeper experience call for other roles) which leads to a virtual or in person interview panel. We prioritize transparency and lack of surprise throughout the process.



What if I need accommodations for my interview?

At Watershed, we are dedicated to ensuring an inclusive recruitment process. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities, long-term conditions, mental health needs, religious observances, neurodivergence, or pregnancy-related support requirements. If you need assistance during your process, please contact your recruiter.

postings.text:
ABOUT WATERSHED

We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team.



We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!




THE ROLE

At Watershed, GTM enablement & strategy exists to drive business outcomes by enabling every GTM and Customer Org employee to be the best they can be in their role. We do this by helping teams navigate Watershed's ecosystem (people, products, systems, and information), supporting their mastery of our products and services, and helping people build craft in their roles.

We're rebuilding our GTM enablement & strategy function, and we're looking for a GTM Enablement Manager, Revenue Excellence to play a critical role in that rebuild. In this role, you'll partner closely with Sales and Customer Success leaders to coach, train, and develop reps so they can hit and exceed their goals. You'll also help drive the rollout and mastery of Watershed's most strategic initiatives across our customer-facing teams.

This role can be based in our San Francisco or New York offices. Some travel is required to support team offsites and cross-office enablement sessions.




YOU WILL

 - Support the rollout, adoption, and mastery of Watershed initiatives (products, services, processes) by working closely with SMEs to deliver clear, accurate, and engaging enablements.

 - Build trainings and programs that improve new revenue and retention outcomes through rep skill development and coaching.

 - Partner with Sales and Customer Success leadership to identify skill gaps, build coaching plans that drive improvements in key sales metrics (e.g. pipeline generation, win rates, ARR, GRR, NRR).

 - Partner with GTM Ops on call reviews, deal inspection, and forecasting practices to raise the bar on field execution.

 - Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Customer, Product, Marketing, and Ops to translate Watershed strategy into field-ready execution.


YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF YOU

 - Have 6+ years of experience in sales enablement, sales operations, or a closely related function in B2B Enterprise SaaS or complex enterprise environments.

 - Have operated in or closely supported a quota-carrying or ARR-influencing role, and have a strong point of view on what great sales and customer success execution looks like.

 - Have demonstrated experience building and scaling enablement strategies that drive measurable sales performance. You’re outcome oriented, and focus on driving real results.

 - Have led complex, cross-functional projects end-to-end while partnering with Sales, Customer, Product, Marketing, and Ops functions.

 - Are excited to leverage AI in how you work and how you partner with other teams. You're a visible and credible champion for internal AI adoption.

 - Have excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to convey complex concepts clearly and adapt content for different audiences.

 - Are comfortable with ambiguity and excited to help build a function from the ground up.

Where we have offices, employees are expected to be in office for 4 days per week. Corporate Planning & Consolidation

 - Finance partner to Product, Engineering, Design & Science on spend and resourcing decisions

 - 6-8+ years in FP&A, Strategic Finance, or Investment Banking / Venture Capital / Private Equity, including 2+ years inside a high-growth B2B SaaS company

 - Deep understanding of SaaS metrics and recurring revenue mechanics

 - Proven business partnering: able to translate complex financials for non-finance leaders and push back when it matters

Watershed https://watershed.com/ is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!




THE ROLE

Watershed is seeking an experienced Accounting Manager to own our global general ledger accounting, financial close, and audit preparation as we scale. This role will be responsible for accurate financial reporting, strong internal controls, and full audit cycle execution. You'll also directly manage and mentor accounting team members as our accounting team grows.

This is a US GAAP-based role supporting our global, consolidated reporting; knowledge of Mexican statutory/monthly reporting requirements or UK GAAP is a plus, not a requirement.

As Accounting Manager, you'll be the engine behind our financial close process and the point person for audit execution and statutory compliance across all Watershed entities and geographies. You'll own complex technical accounting areas including lease accounting, equity transactions, and tax compliance, while building scalable processes and controls to support our ambitious growth trajectory. Working closely with our Technical Accounting team, external auditors, and cross-functional partners, you'll ensure our financial reporting is accurate, timely, and audit-ready.

This is an exceptional opportunity for someone who thrives in high-growth environments, loves building systems and processes from the ground up, and wants to make a meaningful impact on both our business and global climate action.




WHAT YOU'LL DO



GL Management & Financial Close

 - Manage the global general ledger, chart of accounts, and intercompany accounting.

 - Lead and mentor a growing accounting team, providing technical review and coaching, and building a high-performing, inclusive team dynamic that thrives in a fast-paced environment.

 - Drive  the monthly, quarterly, and annual close process end-to-end across all Watershed entities and geographies, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and timeliness.

 - Own a portfolio of accounts through close, reconciliations, and journal entries.

 - Prepare and own US GAAP financial statements, including building the cash flow statements from the ground up.

 - Perform flux analysis, explaining period-over-period movements across the balance sheet and income statement.

 - Own investor and board-level financial reporting.

 - Architect our group-level intercompany framework, elimination logic, transaction-flow documentation, and sources of truth, designed to absorb new entities and future acquisitions.

 - Streamline our intercompany cost-sharing arrangements (pay-on-behalf-of / collect-on-behalf-of) and redesign and automate the cost-allocation process.



Audit, Technical Accounting & Compliance

 - Serve as primary point person for external audits, preparing comprehensive documentation (PBC lists, workpapers, flowcharts, walkthroughs) and coordinating all audit activities, ensuring deliverables are consistently audit-ready with clear supporting evidence.

 - Apply technical US GAAP guidance in key areas including allocations, cashflow, carbon credit accounting, COGS, fixed-assets, FX, lease accounting, and stock-based compensation.

 - Take ownership of tax compliance across multiple jurisdictions and coordinate with external advisors.

 - Manage the accounting and reporting requirements for unique legal entities, including consolidation assessments and entity-level reporting.



Process Innovation, Technology & Cross-Functional Partnership

 - Co-own our ERP system with our Finance Systems leads, partnering on configuration, controls, and platform decisions as the accounting function's needs evolve.

 - Act as a tech-forward accounting partner, identifying opportunities to automate tasks through ERP features, AI tools, or emerging technologies, and translating ambiguous business needs into scalable accounting and operational frameworks.

 - Identify bottlenecks in current processes and implement solutions, if something is manual and time-consuming, redesign or automate it.

 - Support ad-hoc projects such as system implementations, new business or entity launches, data quality enhancements, or technical accounting research.

 - Partner with Technical Accounting, FP&A, Legal, People, and Operations teams to support business initiatives and provide accounting guidance across the organization.




YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU HAVE:

 - 8+ years of progressive accounting experience in SaaS or tech companies, with demonstrated experience leading audit preparation and execution. Big 4 accounting firm experience is a plus.

 - Deep proficiency in US GAAP with hands-on technical accounting experience including cash flow preparation.

 - Strong experience with financial close and multi-entity/global GL management and accounting.

 - Deep working knowledge of ERP systems (e.g. NetSuite, Workday, Rillet), advanced Excel/Google Sheets experience, and a proven track record of using AI tools to eliminate low-value accounting work.

 - Experience building, managing and mentoring high performing, diverse teams that thrive in a fast paced environment.

 - Exceptional ability to work independently, thrive in ambiguity, and manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to translate complex accounting positions into plain language for non-accounting partners.

 - Knowledge of Mexican statutory accounting (SAT compliance) and/or UK GAAP is a plus.

 - Fluency in English is required.

 - Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field, plus CPA, CPC (Contador Público Certificado), or an international equivalent preferred.

Where we have offices, employees are expected to be in office for 4 days per week.
